title: VMC Programmer
description:
We are looking for an experienced VMC Programmer with 7–8 years of hands-on experience in mould manufacturing and machining. The candidate should have strong knowledge of CNC/VMC programming, mould machining, technical drawings, and machining operations. The ideal candidate must be capable of independently handling programming and ensuring accurate, high-quality production.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute VMC programs for mould manufacturing and machining.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, 2D drawings, and 3D models.
* Prepare CNC/VMC tool paths and machining strategies.
* Handle mould components, mould inserts, cavities, and core machining.
* Select appropriate cutting tools, speeds, feeds, and machining parameters.
* Perform program testing, simulation, and troubleshooting.
* Optimize machining cycles to improve productivity and accuracy.
* Coordinate with the tool room and production teams.
* Ensure dimensional accuracy and maintain quality standards.
* Identify and resolve machining and programming-related issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 7–8 years of relevant experience in VMC programming.
* Strong experience in mould manufacturing and mould machining.
* Knowledge of CNC/VMC programming and machining processes.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and understand GD&T.
* Experience with CAD/CAM software such as PowerMill, Mastercam, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of cutting tools, tool selection, and machining parameters.
* Ability to work independently and manage machining jobs.

Salary & Working Details

* **CTC:** ₹45,000 per month
* **Experience:** 7–8 Years
* **Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* **Job Type:** Full-Time

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
